name: Logo Showcase – Carousel, Slider, Grid & List for WordPress
author: pickelements

sections.description:
Logo Showcase is a lightweight and fully responsive WordPress plugin that helps you showcase client logos, partner brands, sponsors, or portfolio items in a professional way. Create stunning logo displays instantly using a simple shortcode system.

With bulk image upload, drag & drop ordering, and flexible styling options, you can build a modern logo section in minutes.

Why Choose Logo Showcase?

  • Beginner-friendly interface
  • No coding required
  • Fully responsive design
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Lightweight and fast loading
  • Multiple layout options (Carousel, Slider, Grid, List)

Live Demo & Resources

Live Preview
Documentation
Video Tutorial
Upgrade to Pro

Key Features

Layout & Design

  • Carousel, Slider, Grid & List layouts
  • Fully responsive design
  • Touch & swipe support
  • Mobile optimized UI

Logo Management

  • One-click bulk logo upload
  • Unlimited logos support
  • Drag & drop ordering
  • External & internal link support
  • Logo title, description & “Read More” support

Styling Options

  • Custom logo height control (default/custom)
  • Grayscale / normal image style
  • Border color & hover effects
  • Tooltip enable/disable
  • Typography control (title & description)
  • Full color customization

Slider Settings

  • Autoplay enable/disable
  • Autoplay speed control
  • Items per view (desktop/tablet/mobile)
  • Navigation arrows toggle
  • Pagination dots toggle
  • Swipe & drag support

Grid Settings

  • Column control system
  • Adjustable spacing
  • Border customization
  • Responsive layout control

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to “Logo Showcase → Add New Showcase”
  3. Upload logos in bulk
  4. Customize layout and design
  5. Copy shortcode
  6. Paste anywhere on your website

Simple. Fast. Powerful. No coding required.

Shortcode

Use this shortcode to display your logo showcase:

[piclogofree id=”123″]

Take your logo showcase to the next level with advanced design control, animations, and premium layouts.

Free version is perfect for basic use — but Pro is designed for professional websites, agencies, and high-converting landing pages.

sections.installation:
Via WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Logo Showcase”
  3. Click Install & Activate
  4. Find “Logo Showcase” menu in dashboard

Via FTP

  1. Extract plugin zip file
  2. Upload folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate plugin from WordPress admin

Usage

After activation:

  1. Go to Logo Showcase → Add New Showcase
  2. Upload your logos in bulk
  3. Configure settings
  4. Copy shortcode
  5. Paste into page, post, or widget
sections.faq:
Is this plugin beginner friendly?

Yes. No coding is required. Everything is controlled from the admin panel.

Can I upload unlimited logos?

Yes. You can add unlimited logos without restrictions.

Does it work with Elementor or Gutenberg?

Yes. It works with any page builder or default WordPress editor.

Is it responsive?

Yes. It is fully responsive and optimized for all devices.

Can I customize the design?

Yes. You can customize colors, spacing, borders, typography, and layout styles.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. It is compatible with all modern WordPress themes.

Need Support?

Contact: pickelements@gmail.com
